original_test_intent: Verify approved MRDIMM identity, population, capacity, slots1-24 topology and Linux memory accounting, and reject the prohibited Genoa plus6400-DIMM profile in favor of5600.
original_method: Operator captures BIOS slots1-24 and CPU platform; agent securely collects complete DMI, meminfo, free and NUMA evidence; engineer compares part/type/speed/population and accounting to the approved MRDIMM platform recipe.
manual_activity: Operator/KVM captures CPU platform and BIOS slots1-24; engineer supplies the approved MRDIMM speed/population recipe; agent collects secure Linux evidence.
required_inputs: Approved CPU/board/BIOS and MRDIMM part/type/rank/capacity/configured/effective-speed population matrix
Explicit platform applicability including Genoa5600-not6400 constraint
Qualified operator/KVM and BIOS slot map
Secure Linux DMI/meminfo/free/NUMA tools and evidence storage
Installed-versus-usable accounting plus ECC/SEL/thermal abort and recovery policy
safety_requirements: Read-only inspection; no reseat or BIOS speed change
Preserve all populated/empty slots and raw speed/type fields
Stop on wrong platform, Genoa plus6400, ECC/SEL errors, unstable boot or contradictory topology
agent_execution_scope: Collect operator BIOS evidence and secure full OS memory/topology records
Compare CPU platform, each MRDIMM and effective/configured speed to the supplied matrix
Flag Genoa plus6400 before any acceptance; do not change hardware/BIOS or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide authoritative MRDIMM/CPU platform and speed recipe
Resolve slot/accounting discrepancies and any prohibited profile

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partial only: generic DMI supports inventory but unsafe SSH, installed-only filtering and absent CPU/speed/BIOS/accounting checks leave core coverage unmet.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After manual BIOS capture, securely collect unfiltered dmidecode Type17, meminfo, free and NUMA/topology plus CPU identity and effective speed.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: MRDIMM, BIOS/Linux, slots1-24, count/size/accounting, Genoa5600-not6400 and1/1 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Join each BIOS/DMI slot and MRDIMM identity to the CPU-platform recipe, corroborate effective speed, then reconcile Linux accounting.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete provenance, CPU/speed enforcement, secure collection, health aborts and recovery boundaries.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Generic DMI inventory cannot prove the Genoa compatibility rule or full BIOS/accounting coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS configured and actual speed fields may differ by firmware; memory training can down-clock modules, so the approved effective-speed rule must govern.

project_override_considerations: Project must provide the authoritative CPU/MRDIMM compatibility table and installed-versus-usable tolerance; the explicit Genoa5600-not6400 rule is not weakened.
expected_evidence: BIOS Memory Topology screenshots for slots1-24
Complete Type17 records including empty slots, part/serial/type/rank/size/configured/effective speed/ECC/locator
Explicit platform rule result showing no Genoa plus6400 profile

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The MRDIMM inventory and explicit Genoa5600-not6400 constraint are internally consistent. Exact approved platform/part/population and accounting thresholds are project readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operator, specification and read-only tools can be supplied; a detected prohibited configuration is a testcase result for engineering, not a reason to invalidate this static review.

review_improvement: Restores the source's CPU-platform speed constraint and BIOS/accounting coverage omitted by the DMI-only prior review.
independent_technical_reasoning: MRDIMM identity and nominal module rating do not alone prove a supported operating profile. Firmware training determines configured/effective speed, and a6400-rated module on Genoa directly violates the source rule even if SMBIOS enumerates it. CPU identity, module part, slot map and trained speed must therefore be evaluated together.
